sql: SELECT metric, val FROM ( SELECT 'strategies_total' metric, count(*)::text val, 1 o FROM evo_strategies UNION ALL SELECT 'strategy_status:'||status, count(*)::text, 2 FROM evo_strategies GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'agent_backtest_dataset:'||coalesce(dataset,'?'), count(*)::text, 3 FROM evo_sandbox_runs WHERE kind='backtest' GROUP BY dataset UNION ALL SELECT 'sandbox_kind:'||kind, count(*)::text, 4 FROM evo_sandbox_runs GROUP BY kind UNION ALL SELECT 'orders_status:'||coalesce(status,'?'), count(*)::text, 5 FROM evo_orders GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'fills_total', count(*)::text, 6 FROM evo_fills UNION ALL SELECT 'positions_status:'||coalesce(status,'?'), count(*)::text, 7 FROM evo_positions GROUP BY status ) t ORDER BY o, metric
